messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished for service-inference -> prod (canary=10%) image=redwood/service-inference:v2.13.0. Post-deploy synthetic coverage job kicked off. Will run regional probes and prefix KV checks.

maya: saw a small uptick in synth failures for eu1 shortly after the canary started (~00:03 after deploy). p95 for /embed-route jumped. Not huge but correlated with synth errors.

toni: can you paste the synth logs? was it 5xx or timeouts?

maya: quick paste from the probe run: 
```
[2026-03-21T00:03:12Z] synth-check eu1 embed-route id=cc3a status=502 error="upstream read timeout"
[2026-03-21T00:03:12Z] synth-check eu1 kv-prefix id=cc3b status=200 latency_ms=45
[2026-03-21T00:03:15Z] synth-check eu1 embed-route id=cc4a status=429 error="rate-limited"
```

liam: I ran a quick replay against canary GWs, couldn't reproduce 502s locally. Seeing a few 429s from the inference-proxy in eu1 with bursty token-rate.

sre-bot: Metrics snapshot: eu1 embed-route p95 went 120ms -> 310ms, error rate +0.6% (relative). Queue depth for proxy workers spiked briefly to 7 (baseline 1-2). No large OOMs.

toni: hmm. sounds like transient overload + backpressure at the proxy layer. Is canary traffic distribution skewed?

deploy-bot: Canary distribution: eu1=30% of canary traffic (based on routing weights), uswest=40%, apac=30%. Canary autoscale target pods currently at min replicas due to config.

nora: proposal: pause rollout, keep canary at 10% but disable eu1 routing to canary for a few minutes so we can validate without eu noise. Also consider enabling fallback to model-quantized variant for embed-route in eu1 while we diagnose.

maya: agree with pausing eu1. If we remove eu1 from canary routing we can watch other regions for any systemic regression.

liam: I can flip eu1 out of canary routing now. Will also scale proxy workers +1 in eu1 to see if queue pressure eases.

toni: hold on rollback for now. No evidence of model correctness regressions, only capacity/backpressure signals. Rolling back would lose the telemetry we need.

deploy-bot: Action: pausing eu1 canary weight -> 0% (effective canary still 10% in other regions). Assigned @liam to scale proxy workers and watch for synth pass. Assigned @maya to run focused replay on eu1 embed requests.

sre-bot: ETA for metric stabilization: watch 5m windows. If p95 doesn't return to baseline in 10m, escalate to rollback or autoscaler policy update.

nora: also add a short-term pin option: if we need to pin routes in eu1 to v2.12.9, we should prepare the routing rule and release notes. But prefer to avoid pin unless errors persist after infra adjustments.

maya: replay in progress. will report back in ~6m.

liam: eu1 proxy scaled +1, removed eu1 from canary routing. monitoring.

maya: replay results: replayed a batch of 200 embed requests against canary in eu1 (same request mix). No 502s seen after scaling; a couple of 429s early but they cleared as queue dropped. Synth coverage job re-run shows green for apac/uswest.

toni: great. sounds like capacity tunable rather than model regressions. Keep canary paused for 30m and observe. If stable, resume full rollout with autoscaler config change to avoid min replicas trap.

nora: I'll open a short follow-up PR for the autoscaler policy + add a preflight check to ensure min_replicas >= 2 for heavy routes. Also drafting release-note blurb mentioning the temporary hold and the autoscale tweak.

deploy-bot: Canary remains at 10% (eu1 excluded). No rollback. Follow-up items: autoscaler PR (#TBD) by @nora, postmortem if reoccurred, final rollout resume checklist.

maya: thanks all. tagging :eyes: for 30m watch.

liam: will keep an eye on proxy queue. ping me if it blips.

toni: nice coordinated triage, thanks. :thumbsup:
